title: Key the pinned agent map on roles and retire the extraction-kind refusal text
action: Slice 2, the CARRIER for D12 (store 8dad7c2e). SCOPE WIDENED 2026-08-25 after this cell's own [BLOCKED] report: jobs 1 and 3 already landed in commit b832e6b4 (role-keyed ROLE_AGENTS with one home in drivers/guard.rs; the hook's twin PINNED_AGENT_TYPE deleted; all six phantom --kind refusal strings retired along with dispatch_kind_for_tier, replaced by dispatch_kind_for_role derived from slot_for_kind; the wording test retargeted to the stronger claim; the a2f85972 fence decided and documented as derived rather than hand-widened). What remains is job 2 alone, and it needs the two files just added. Per decision 8ff6e79e, add an optional --role <name> flag to bee dispatch prepare: when present it names the slot to resolve directly so the kind's default slot is not consulted, resolved through the shared role resolver; when absent every existing invocation keeps today's bytes exactly. So --kind gather --role extraction returns the bee-extract worker, which is 8dad7c2e's recorded defect finally closed. Do NOT remap --kind gather onto extraction (the silent behavior change 8dad7c2e refused) and do NOT honour a cell's recorded role on --kind gather or --kind reviewer (a gather ABOUT a cell is not the cell's own job). The flag is caller-facing, so its catalog/help entry must be correct and the CLI-shape guard must accept it. The regen chain and the mirror trees belong to mrs-7 — if your change requires regen, say so on the cap and leave it to mrs-7 rather than running it here.

truths: bee dispatch prepare --kind gather --role extraction returns the bee-extract worker
Absent --role, every existing prepare invocation is byte-identical to before
The flag is refused cleanly when it names a role nothing configures, with a FIX naming the configured roles
No refusal text names a remedy that does not exist
A role with no rendered agent yields no pinned type rather than a generic or invented one
The cap states what regen mrs-7 still owes, if any
